svg.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: Latchwing concept: what is inside
svg.desc: Isometric illustration of the housing pulled apart to show each part: lid, low-power board, lithium cells and desiccant pack, base, a downward cable gland, the sensor and a separate magnet. It is a concept, parts are not chosen.
svg.text: Sleeps until a door moves. Keeps
events sealed in flash. Needs a
hardware RNG and a debug lock.
Better than alkaline in the cold.
